branch_delivery_addresses_decision_ck.name: branch_delivery_addresses_decision_ck
branch_delivery_addresses_decision_ck.value:
CASE WHEN "branch_delivery_addresses"."status" = 'pending'
            THEN "branch_delivery_addresses"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "branch_delivery_addresses"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
            ELSE "branch_delivery_addresses"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "branch_delivery_addresses"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          END

branches_org_external_identity_uq.name: branches_org_external_identity_uq
branches_org_external_identity_uq.where: "branches"."external_source" IS NOT NULL AND "branches"."external_id" IS NOT NULL

branches_external_identity_pair_ck.name: branches_external_identity_pair_ck
branches_external_identity_pair_ck.value:
("branches"."external_source" IS NULL) = ("branches"."external_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("branches"."external_source" IS NULL OR (btrim("branches"."external_source") <> '' AND btrim("branches"."external_id") <> ''))

orders_amounts_nonnegative_ck.name: orders_amounts_nonnegative_ck
orders_amounts_nonnegative_ck.value: "orders"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_cents" >= 0 AND COALESCE("orders"."refund_amount_cents", 0) >= 0 AND COALESCE("orders"."refund_amount_cents", 0) <= "orders"."total_cents"

orders_idempotency_pair_ck.name: orders_idempotency_pair_ck
orders_idempotency_pair_ck.value: ("orders"."idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "orders"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."request_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL)

organization_join_requests_scope_shape_c.name: organization_join_requests_scope_shape_ck
organization_join_requests_scope_shape_c.value:
CASE WHEN "organization_join_requests"."requested_role" IN ('BRANCH_ADMIN', 'ORDER_PORTAL')
            THEN "organization_join_requests"."requested_branch_id" IS NOT NULL
              AND jsonb_array_length("organization_join_requests"."requested_group_ids") = 0
              AND jsonb_array_length("organization_join_requests"."requested_branch_ids") = 0
            ELSE "organization_join_requests"."requested_branch_id" IS NULL
              AND jsonb_array_length("organization_join_requests"."requested_group_ids") + jsonb_array_length("organization_join_requests"."requested_branch_ids") > 0
          END

organization_join_requests_decision_ck.name: organization_join_requests_decision_ck
organization_join_requests_decision_ck.value:
CASE WHEN "organization_join_requests"."status" = 'pending'
            THEN "organization_join_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "organization_join_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_join_requests"."created_user_id" IS NULL
            ELSE "organization_join_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_join_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          END

organization_settings_session_timeout_bo.name: organization_settings_session_timeout_bounds_ck
organization_settings_session_timeout_bo.value: "organization_settings"."key" <> 'session_timeout_minutes' OR CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("organization_settings"."value") = 'number' AND ("organization_settings"."value" #>> '{}') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN ("organization_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 15 ELSE FALSE END

password_reset_challenges_verification_c.name: password_reset_challenges_verification_ck
password_reset_challenges_verification_c.value:
("password_reset_challenges"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "password_reset_challenges"."reset_token_digest" IS NULL AND "password_reset_challenges"."reset_token_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("password_reset_challenges"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "password_reset_challenges"."reset_token_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "password_reset_challenges"."reset_token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

product_quantity_budgets_values_valid_ck.name: product_quantity_budgets_values_valid_ck
product_quantity_budgets_values_valid_ck.value: "product_quantity_budgets"."allocated_quantity" >= 0 AND "product_quantity_budgets"."held_quantity" >= 0 AND "product_quantity_budgets"."used_quantity" >= 0 AND "product_quantity_budgets"."credited_quantity" >= 0 AND "product_quantity_budgets"."amount_allocated_cents" >= 0 AND "product_quantity_budgets"."amount_credited_cents" >= 0 AND ("product_quantity_budgets"."allocated_quantity" + "product_quantity_budgets"."credited_quantity") >= ("product_quantity_budgets"."held_quantity" + "product_quantity_budgets"."used_quantity")

users_org_external_identity_role_uq.name: users_org_external_identity_role_uq
users_org_external_identity_role_uq.where: "users"."external_source" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."external_id" IS NOT NULL

users_external_identity_pair_ck.name: users_external_identity_pair_ck
users_external_identity_pair_ck.value:
("users"."external_source" IS NULL) = ("users"."external_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("users"."external_source" IS NULL OR (btrim("users"."external_source") <> '' AND btrim("users"."external_id") <> ''))
